title: 第14章 洞府

content_zh:
“无天哥哥，你没有打扰到我，这些年，除了爹爹和小依，我从来没有见过其他人，你是第一个，无天哥哥，你能不能留下玩几天，陪我说说话。”诗诗笑得很甜，带着恳求，让人不忍拒绝。
无天道：“你不怕我是坏人吗？”
“无天哥哥不是坏人，小依能看透人心，如果你心底不善，它不会让你靠近，更不会让你抚摸。”
飞天狐轻声低鸣，猩红的舌头，舔了下她的小手，她被逗得咯咯直笑。
“无天哥哥，小依说，你心里有很深的怨恨，化不开的悲伤，但不会伤害我，可以和你玩。”她轻抚着小依的毛发，声音清脆动听，大眼睛眨着，尽是期盼。
小女孩太可爱，无天实在无法狠下心婉拒，沉默了少许，微笑道：“如此美丽的地方，还有这么可爱的小妹妹挽留，我若不答应……”
“耶！无天哥哥答应了，诗诗太开心了。”没等他说完，小女孩就蹦跳了起来，宛如一个小精灵，在草坪上欢呼雀跃。
诗诗很自然的挽着无天手臂，道：“无天哥哥，其实你笑起来很好看，以后就别整天哭着脸，学我一样，天天开心快乐，无忧无虑，才不会变老喔！”
无天笑着点了点头，诗诗的善良纯真，将他感染，一时间竟忘记许多烦恼，心里一下放松了不少。
“无天哥哥，我带你去看小花，它可漂亮了，你一定会喜欢它的，告诉你哟，你可别欺负它，它可是诗诗最好的朋友。”
“无天哥哥，我告诉你个秘密，昨天我忘记给小花浇水，害它差点死掉了，早晨我去看它的时候，它无力的坐在花盆，我都快伤心死了，幸好它又活了，我好高兴。”
拉着他朝着阁楼走去，诗诗一路上蹦蹦跳跳，叽叽喳喳，讲个不停，仿佛要把这十二没说的话，一次说不来。
无天笑逐颜开，静静听着。
这里风景宜人，清净而优雅，远离世俗间，是一个修身养性的好地方，无天索性放开心怀，将所有的事情暂时放下，好好轻松下。
他陪诗诗去看了小花，那是一株很普通的野花，山脉中到处都是，但诗诗却把它看做朋友，精心养育，不间断浇水修剪，日复一日，年复一年。
小天心里美滋滋的，虽得到警告，不准打小依的主意，但只要能留下来，就不愁没有机会。而飞天狐似乎并没给它一丝机会，时刻都跟来诗诗与无天身旁，让它无法下手。
这让它心痒牙痒，全身都发痒。
“快看那边，好多吉祥鹿，还有这边，美丽的雀凰，哇！十几头白麟，无天哥哥你快看呀，它们都出来和你打招呼了。”
四周成群的妖兽走出，围着诗诗戏耍，它们狰狞可怕，但在这个小天使面前，犹如绵羊般温顺，没有一点凶气。
这一天，无天去了很多地方，见到了各式各样的野花，人畜无害的灵兽。这里当真是一片净土，没有杀戮，没有纠纷，也没有仇恨，更没有贪欲，一切都是那么简单，纯真！

夜晚，皓月当空，星光璀璨，两人两兽坐在池塘边，欣赏月色。
诗诗仰着小脑袋，道：“爹爹说，天空上每一颗星星都代表一个人，而他就是最灿烂的那颗，所以每次我想念爹爹的时候，都会在这里看星星，希望能找到属于爹爹的那颗，但每一颗都那么明亮，到底那一颗才是爹爹，无天哥哥你知道吗？”
她两只胳膊抱着腿，较小的身子缩在一起，如黑宝石的美眸中，倒影着星月，充满了思念与孤寂，让人心疼。
“诗诗，你爹爹说的很对，每个人都是一颗星星，其中有几颗就是我们的家人，当他们不在我们身边时，就会在天空默默注视着，关心着我们，他们不曾离开过，一直都在静静的守护。”
曾经何时，他也一样，夜晚仰望星空，希望父母能出现在面前，但十六年过去，人一直没出现，只是空期望。但他不想让诗诗的希望破灭，不想让她因为爹爹的谎言而难过，没有说出事实。
“诗诗，你看，那颗明亮的星星就是你爹爹，他忽闪忽闪的，在对你眨眼呢！”无天指着天空，微笑道。
“真的吗？”
“嗯，哥哥怎么会骗你呢。”无天点头。
诗诗喜悦，对着夜空，大声道：“爹爹，我终于找到你了，诗诗好想你。”

content_en:
"Brother Wutian, you didn't disturb me. In these years, except for dad and Xiaoyi, I have never seen anyone else. You are the first one. Brother Wutian, can you stay and play for a few days and talk to me." Shishi smiled sweetly, with a pleading tone that made people unable to bear to refuse.
Wutian said: "Aren't you afraid that I am a bad person?"
"Brother Wutian is not a bad person. Xiaoyi can see through people's hearts. If you are not kind at heart, he will not let you get close to him, let alone touch him."
The flying fox murmured softly, and licked her little hand with its scarlet tongue, making her giggle.
"Brother Wutian, Xiaoyi said that you have deep resentment and irresolvable sadness in your heart, but you won't hurt me and you can play with you." She stroked Xiaoyi's hair, her voice was clear and sweet, and her big eyes blinked with expectation.
The little girl was so cute that Wutian couldn't bear to refuse. He was silent for a while and said with a smile: "Such a beautiful place, and such a lovely little sister, if I don't agree..."
"Yeah! Brother Wutian agreed, Shishi is so happy." Before he could finish speaking, the little girl jumped up, like an elf, cheering on the lawn.
Shishi naturally held Wutian's arm and said, "Brother Wutian, you actually look good when you smile. Don't cry all day long in the future. Be like me and be happy and carefree every day, so you won't grow old!"
Wutian smiled and nodded. Shishi's kindness and innocence infected him. He forgot many worries for a while and felt much more relaxed.
"Brother Wutian, let me take you to see the little flower. It is so beautiful. You will definitely like it. Let me tell you, don't bully it. It is Shishi's best friend."
"Brother Wutian, let me tell you a secret. I forgot to water the little flower yesterday and it almost died. When I went to see it in the morning, it was sitting powerlessly in the flower pot. I almost died of sadness. Fortunately, it is alive again. I am so happy."
Pulling him towards the attic, Shishi jumped up and down, chattered and talked non-stop, as if she wanted to finish the twelve unsaid words at once.
Wutian smiled broadly and listened quietly.
The scenery here is pleasant, clean and elegant, far away from the worldly world. It is a good place to cultivate one's moral character. Wutian simply relaxes his mind, puts everything aside temporarily, and relaxes.
He accompanied Shishi to see the little flower. It was a very common wild flower that could be found everywhere in the mountains, but Shishi regarded it as a friend and raised it carefully, watering and pruning it continuously, day after day, year after year.
Xiaotian felt very happy. Although he was warned not to take advantage of Xiaoyi, as long as he could stay, he would not worry about not having a chance. The Feitian Fox didn't seem to give it a chance. It followed Shishi and Wutian all the time, making it impossible for it to make a move.
This made his heart itch, his teeth itch, and his whole body itch.
"Look over there, there are a lot of auspicious deer, and here, there are beautiful phoenixes, wow! More than a dozen white lins, Brother Wutian, look, they are all coming out to say hello to you."
Groups of monsters came out from all around and played around Shishi. They were ferocious and terrifying, but in front of this little angel, they were as docile as sheep, without any ferocity.
On this day, Wutian went to many places and saw all kinds of wild flowers and spiritual beasts that were harmless to humans and animals. This is really a pure land, there is no killing, no disputes, no hatred, no greed, everything is so simple and innocent!
At night, with the bright moon in the sky and the stars shining brightly, the two of them sat by the pond and admired the moonlight.
Shishi raised her little head and said: "Dad said that every star in the sky represents a person, and he is the brightest one, so every time I miss my dad, I will look at the stars here, hoping to find the one that belongs to dad, but every one is so bright, which one is dad, brother Wutian, do you know?"
She hugged her legs with her arms,The smaller bodies huddled together, and the stars and moon were reflected in the beautiful eyes like black gems, full of longing and loneliness, which made people feel heartbroken.
"Shishi, your father is right. Everyone is a star, and some of them are our family members. When they are no longer around us, they will silently watch and care about us in the sky. They have never left and have always been quietly guarding us."
Once upon a time, he was the same, looking up at the stars at night, hoping that his parents would appear in front of him, but sixteen years later, they never appeared, and it was just empty hope. But he didn't want Shishi's hope to be dashed, and he didn't want her to feel sad because of her father's lies and not tell the truth.
"Shishi, look, that bright star is your daddy. He is flickering and blinking at you!" Wutian pointed to the sky and smiled.
"Really?"
"Well, how could my brother lie to you?" Wutian nodded.
Shishi was so happy that she said loudly to the night sky: "Daddy, I finally found you. Shishi misses you so much."
